title: diff-review reviewer verdict
description: The machine-read summary of one independent diff review. The reviewer's full narrative reasoning is returned separately and is not replaced by this object.

findings.description: Every finding, most-severe first. An empty array means nothing substantive was found — say that plainly rather than inventing nits.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the file the finding is in.

severity.description: blocker = wrong in a way that breaks correctness, security, or data integrity, must not merge; major = a real correctness or robustness defect to fix before merge, but not catastrophic; minor = a small correctness or clarity issue safe to defer; nit = style or preference with no correctness impact. A phase gate keys on this, so label accurately.

summary.description: What is wrong, plus the suggested direction — a direction, never an applied edit.

failure_scenario.description: The concrete failure this causes: specific inputs or state leading to the wrong output, crash, or exposure. If the concern is uncertain, say so and state what would confirm it.

overall.description: The verdict in prose: whether the change is correct as written, and what the reader should do about it.

blocking_count.description: How many findings are severity blocker or major — the count a phase gate acts on. It must equal the number of such entries in `findings`; the supervisor recomputes it and reports any disagreement.
